policy: Public promotion requires every blocking gate to have verifiable PASS evidence on the release candidate or an explicitly disclosed non-blocking status approved by governance.

gates.purpose: A new user can perceive the core OFU thesis without project-specific coaching.
Release candidate passes the required exact-head and same-SHA certification matrix.
The published artifact is reproducible and traceable to exact source.
License application and material provenance are reviewed before large-scale external contribution/commercial relicensing.
A reviewed contributor-rights mechanism exists before commercial relicensing of third-party contributions is represented as available.
A private vulnerability reporting path is available before broad public promotion.
A stranger can discover, classify, verify and submit work without founder coaching.
Risk, ownership and contribution routing are machine readable and CI checked.
Public scientific claims match measured/model authority and uncertainty.
Browser/mobile/device claims exactly match executed evidence and explicitly disclose unverified physical-device coverage.
README, launch page, release notes and demo claims are audited against the exact candidate.
PR/release automation follows least privilege, immutable action references and exact-source verification.
